question: Simplify [ (22 times 6) times left{8 div 4 times (15 - (11)/(4))right}]
solution:

[ (22 × 6) × {8 ÷ 4 × (15 - dfrac{11}{4})}]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations: Brackets → Division/Multiplication → Addition/Subtraction

**Calculation:**

[ (22 × 6) × {8 ÷ 4 × (15 - dfrac{11}{4})}]

⇒ [ (22 × 6) × {8 ÷ 4 × (15 - 2.75)}]

⇒ [ (22 × 6) × {8 ÷ 4 × 12.25}]

⇒ [ (22 × 6) × {2 × 12.25}]

⇒ [ (22 × 6) × 24.5]

⇒ [ 132 × 24.5]

⇒ [ 3234 ]

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
